evidence_limits: Original material comes from the pinned repository. New files only extract or capture existing content and record verification; no experiments or checker execution were performed.
This collection is pinned specifically to feature/torch-osqp-dense-reference; no default-branch or archived sparse/CG/CUDA Graph visual was substituted.

The branch tree has no benchmark CSV/JSON outputs or OSQP performance figure. The copied audit is dated 2026-07-04 and reports historical local/CI evidence; its underlying manifests were not present in this tree or reverified.
The 12.48x,21.33x,43.46x numbers are documented CUDA-to-builtin-CPU latency ratios (slowdowns), not speedups. All exceed the documented maximum5x performance gate.
Test fixture H=I2, f=(-1,-2), bounds0..1 and expected solution(1,1) are source assertions, not measured solver output.
No residual-vs-iteration curve, convergence trace, current pass count, current CUDA qualification, native sparse capability, MSI readiness or release readiness is established.
The source audit calls CUDA unpromoted and ROCm/MPS unclaimed. No new solver execution was performed.
